sources.feature_id: FID 879; BLDG_ABBR PKRW; Winifred Parker Residence Hall; 1196 3rd Street
sources.method: Transformed source ring using the project's documented local approximation (X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274 degrees), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040), then centered on the manifest placement origin (-544.25, 42.425). Compared the upper structural shell outline directly with the transformed polygon.
sources.uncertainty: The feature geometry is not a survey and uses an approximate local conversion. Its legacy Shape__Area attribute disagrees with area computed from the returned polygon; source boundary was used because its perimeter/bounds correspond to the building trace.

sources.relevant_evidence: Describes suites/semi-suites, floor-to-ceiling windows, study and lounge uses, ground-floor Starbucks and Third Street Market, and says plan dimensions are approximate.
sources.uncertainty: Program information does not verify individual facade dimensions, structural wall positions, or measured elevations.

sources.use: Facade review indicates red brick, tall narrow punched windows, restrained light trim/sills, a ground-level glass entrance/storefront, and no broad bright story bands like the earlier model.
sources.uncertainty: Single oblique exterior photograph; not enough to confirm every facade, floor-to-floor height, roof configuration, or current condition.

geometry_changes: Removed the full overlapping East Wing box and its six other rectangular wing mass approximations from the candidate, replacing them with one continuous upper-story shell and GIS-outline roof. This preserves a continuous exterior through the wing and avoids the earlier hole-producing duplicate-removal cutaway.

Created one continuous ground-story structural core from the official outline north of the 28.3 m campus-Y storefront datum, leaving the Third Street retail/entry zone open at ground level beneath the continuous upper shell.
Moved 118 East facade window/sill/curtain objects to the source-derived eastern wall edge.
Removed unsupported West facade window/sill bays 0-3 and north facade bay 5 on each upper story.
Reduced the earlier square window aspect and oversized sill/spandrel proportions toward the tall, narrow openings in Purdue's official photo.
Removed the rectangular repeated story bands and water-table boxes that no longer followed the actual perimeter and looked too prominent against the photo.

validation.independent_grade: pending; do not mark complete until a fresh independent grader returns at least 8/10

remaining_uncertainties: Purdue GIS NUM_LEVELS says 3 while the same record exposes Floorplans levels 2-5 and CountOfFLO 6; candidate story heights and the six-level interpretation are not survey-verified.
No surveyed elevation, complete as-built drawing, or current multi-elevation photo set was found in this evidence packet; roof/penthouse form and total height remain estimated or unverified.
The GIS outer ring has no courtyard hole; it appears to describe the building outline but cannot resolve interior partition/courtyard conditions.
Ground-floor subtraction north of Y=28.3 m follows the existing storefront datum rather than an as-built floor plan; the open lower retail zone needs visual grading.
The approximate GIS footprint and old Shape__Area attribute conflict. Treat the candidate's exact geometric trace as source alignment, not proof of survey accuracy.
